episodes.synopsis: While singing in a park, Sakuragi Mano is approached by a producer from 283 Productions who is seeking the final idol for a three-member unit to compete at the Wonder Idol Nova Grand Prix.
episodes.title: A Single Feather in a Sky for One

episodes.synopsis: L'Antica chooses to use an elaborate music video for their promotion, but an oncoming storm might put a damper on the fiery passion of their song.
episodes.title: The Flames Called Song

episodes.synopsis: ALSTROEMERIA, uncertain about their future aspirations, try to find their dreams as individuals and as idols while performing at the Spring Flower Festival.
episodes.title: Hopes for the Future

episodes.synopsis: Houkago Climax Girls get ready to perform a show with a popular hero team, but how can they save the day when the heroes can't make it?
episodes.title: Real Heroes!

episodes.synopsis: A date has been chosen for illumination STARS' debut concert. The girls work hard to get in sync.
episodes.title: Our Very Own Formation

episodes.synopsis: The idols of 283 Productions have been accepted to perform at W.I.N.G. and are working hard to prepare. The producer asks each unit to record themselves for a TV documentary.
episodes.title: Everything We Have Now

episodes.synopsis: The Road to W.I.N.G. documentary airs on TV, and the idols of 283 Productions reflect on their performances.
episodes.title: Road to W.I.N.G.

episodes.synopsis: The Producer announces 283 Productions 1st Live, featuring all units. ALSTROEMERIA and The Hokago Climax Girls help promote the show by hosting a radio program.
episodes.title: Shining Upon Each Other

episodes.synopsis: As 283 Production's concert draws near, Mano must choose whether or not to accept the producer's offer and stand in the center.
episodes.title: The First Source of Courage

episodes.synopsis: The girls participate in a two-day training camp, while Mano finds her confidence as the center.
episodes.title: Like a Rainbow of Colors

episodes.synopsis: The Idols of 283 Productions begin their inaugural group performance.
episodes.title: Passing the Baton

episodes.synopsis: As the concert draws to a close, the Idols make their group performance debut.
episodes.title: Spread the Wings!!
